items.title: Jordan Brand and Warner Bros. Premiere 'Space Jam: Beyond The Jam' Documentary Series
items.summary:

Summary 

Jordan Brand and Warner Bros. have officially released the first episode of their new six-part documentary series titled 'Space Jam: Beyond The Jam'The project celebrates the 30th anniversary of the 1996 film by featuring untold stories from Michael Jordan alongside actors and athletesThe remaining five episodes will roll out weekly on YouTube ahead of the highly anticipated return of the Air Jordan 11 Space Jam in December

Jordan Brand and Warner Bros. have officially launched their new six-part documentary series, Space Jam: Beyond the Jam . Celebrating 30 years since the iconic 1996 film first brought Michael Jordan and the Looney Tunes together on the silver screen, the newly released retrospective dives deep into the making of the cultural phenomenon.

The documentary series features exclusive commentary from Michael Jordan himself, alongside various actors, athletes, and behind-the-scenes production staff who helped bring the original live-action and animated hybrid film to life. Through a series of previously untold stories, the weekly episodes explore the ambitious creative decisions behind blending professional basketball with Looney Tunes animation. Furthermore, the retrospective examines the movie’s massive, enduring influence on global basketball fandom and its foundational role in shaping modern sneaker culture.

Tying into this monumental 30th-anniversary celebration, the documentary's rollout arrives just weeks before the highly anticipated return of the Air Jordan 11 "Space Jam." Slated to hit retailers once again this…

items.title: Kevin Feige Discusses Bringing the Original X-Men Cast Into 'Avengers: Doomsday'

Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige has opened up about the decision to bring original X-Men actors into the upcoming film 'Avengers: Doomsday'A recent screenwriting directory listing revealed that actors Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman are credited as writers on the projectThe crossover event will also feature the late Patrick Stewart reprising his role as Charles Xavier for his final on-screen movie appearance

Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige is officially celebrating 25 years of superhero history by returning to the beginning, confirming that several original characters will make their Marvel Cinematic Universe debut in Avengers: Doomsday . Hitting theaters this December, the highly anticipated crossover event will feature the return of foundational franchise stars, including James Marsden as Cyclops, Rebecca Romijn as Mystique, and Patrick Stewart as Professor X.

Speaking with Empire in a recent interview, Feige reflected on the long-awaited crossover between the two iconic superhero teams. “You see interviews of Hugh Jackman 15, 20 years ago saying, ‘People say it’s impossible, but maybe someday the X-Men and the Avengers can all get together.’ It just felt right,” Feige explained. “It just felt like the fun way to culminate a quarter-century of storytelling.”

Jackman’s influence on the project appears to extend beyond archival interview clips. Fans recently discovered that the screenwriting credits for Doomsday list both Jackman and Deadpool star Ryan Reynolds among the 10 writers who contributed to the movie. While the extent of their on-screen…

items.title: Devin Booker Debuts the Nike Book 3 "Twilight" on Court
items.summary:
Summary 

Devin Booker has officially debuted his upcoming third signature sneaker on the hardwoodThe Nike Book 3 was unveiled in a sleek all-black colorway dubbed TwilightAn official release date and pricing details remain unconfirmed by the sportswear brand

Nike and Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker have unofficially unveiled the highly anticipated Nike Book 3 . Giving fans an early look at his third signature shoe, the athlete debuted the unreleased model on the court in a stealthy all-black "Twilight" colorway.

Due to the blacked-out makeup of the "Twilight" iteration, the specific technical elements and nuanced design details remain difficult to discern. However, early on-court glimpses suggest that the forthcoming silhouette maintains the fairly simple, streamlined design language established by its predecessors, bypassing the bulky and futuristic aesthetic commonly found in modern performance basketball footwear.

The appearance of the third iteration indicates a potential shift in Booker’s signature release schedule. Following the nearly two-year lifecycle of the original silhouette and the early 2026 retail arrival of the Book 2, this late-year on-court debut suggests a pivot toward a more traditional annual release cadence. As Nike has yet to officially announce the sneaker, the performance details and the public availability of the "Twilight" colorway remain unknown.

Sperry and BEAMS PLUS have officially joined forces once more to reimagine the iconic Sperry x BEAMS PLUS MIL CVO. Blending the American footwear brand's deep maritime and military heritage with the Japanese label's masterful interpretation of classic Americana, the limited-edition collection elevates the 1935 silhouette with premium, tactile textures.

Drawing direct inspiration from classic Americana suede coats and archival core colors, the latest iteration of the Circular Vamp Oxford swaps traditional canvas for a soft, saturated suede upper. Available in tan, navy, and white, the refined material choice lends the utilitarian silhouette a slightly dressier, sophisticated feel while honoring the design's original connection to footwear issued to the U.S. Navy during World War II.

"The idea behind this collection was to ‘dress up’ the sneaker—a blend of sneaker ease and leather-shoe refinement," explained BEAMS PLUS director Hideki "Harry" Mizobata. "Sperry’s CVO heritage gave us the freedom to reinterpret the style, exploring the balance between casual comfort and classic sophistication." By contemporizing these military-inspired elements, the collaboration offers a fresh expression of both brands' shared affinity for heritage and everyday…

items.title: Bloomingdale’s Casual Roots and Refined Tailoring Collide to Build the Blueprint for Modern Men’s Dressing
items.summary:
Streetwear fundamentally altered luxury and contemporary fashion, but its influence is now splintering into exciting new territories. Today’s style culture is defined by fluid self-expression: music subcultures, West Coast nostalgia, European tailoring, and high-level material craftsmanship all converge into one singular narrative. Men are no longer dressing for rigid occasions or hiding behind uniform silhouettes; instead, they are mixing dramatic proportions with tactile luxury and relaxed elegance. Bloomingdale’s Fall/Winter 2026 collection serves as the ultimate hub for this movement, spotlighting a new wave of design labels taking subcultural codes into sophisticated, elevated realms. 

The West Coast energy that once defined early streetwear has matured into a full-fledged expression of modern luxury. Rhude illustrates this evolution seamlessly, translating speed culture and Americana into elevated off-duty layers like their Desert Graphic-Print Hoodie and Desert Racing Track Jacket . Nearby in the California landscape, Nahmias captures youth subculture through a refined lens with their MVP Logo Star Cotton Crewneck Sweatshirt and the luxurious Loose Fit MVP Leather Bomber Jacket . Meanwhile, Amiri bridges rock-and-roll heritage with haute luxury, executing decadent details in the Beaded Micro Stars Wool & Cashmere Cardigan paired back to essential Vintage Fit Flock Jeans . 

Across the Atlantic, Parisian and Scandinavian influences bring an understated sophistication to modern wardrobing. AMI champions relaxed tailoring and effortless French charm, anchoring current…
items.t: Bloomingdale’s Casual Roots and Refined Tailoring Collide to Build the Blueprint for Modern Men’s Dressing

items.title: CART X Makes History at Retromobile's First New York Edition
items.summary:
Summary 

Retromobile celebrates its 50th anniversary with its first US edition at New York City's Javits Center from November 19–22.CART Department debuts CART X, featuring art cars and works by Keith Haring, Ai Weiwei, Damien Hirst, Jeff Koons and more.CART X partners with Public School New York on custom uniforms and exclusive merchandise, bridging automotive culture, art and fashion.

A new chapter in automotive and cultural history is unfolding in New York City as Retromobile , the renowned French collector car salon, makes its American debut after five decades in Paris. Taking place at the Javits Center from November 19 to 22, 2026, the landmark event will also mark the launch of CART X, a new global platform by CART Department exploring the intersection of automobiles, art, fashion, music and popular culture.

Founded in Paris in 1976, Retromobile has grown from a gathering of automotive enthusiasts and collectors into one of the world's leading celebrations of automotive heritage. Now marking its 50th anniversary, the renowned salon expands beyond France for the first time, bringing its legacy of rare and historic vehicles to New York City.

Founded by art collector Larry Warsh, CART Department marks a major milestone with the debut of CART X, a new global platform exploring the automobile as both an artistic canvas and cultural artifact. The presentation features art cars and works by Keith Haring, Ai Weiwei, Jeff Koons, Shepard Fairey, Damien Hirst, Zaha Hadid, Barbara Kruger, Daniel Arsham, Esther Mahlangu, Olafur Eliasson, Richard Prince and Kenny Scharf.…

Summary 

Robert Pattinson has been officially cast as the next James Bond following months of intense industry speculationThe actor will take over the legendary 007 mantle from Daniel Craig under the direction of Denis VilleneuvePattinson adds the iconic super spy to a dominant 2026 acting resume that includes multiple massive box office successes

Robert Pattinson has officially been cast as the next James Bond . Ending months of rabid industry speculation, Amazon MGM has handed the keys to the Aston Martin to the highly in-demand Batman and Odyssey star, marking the beginning of a new era for the legendary 007 film franchise.

Pattinson will pick up the 007 mantle following Daniel Craig ’s five-movie run as the super spy, which concluded with 2021’s No Time to Die . The highly anticipated casting decision comes after Amazon MGM acquired creative control of the franchise from longtime producers Michael G. Wilson and Barbara Broccoli for $20 million USD. Denis Villeneuve , who previously directed Pattinson in the upcoming Dune: Part Three , was officially tapped to helm the next installment of the Bond series in June 2025. The casting marks a defining moment for Amazon MGM Studios as it looks to carry the six-decade legacy of the franchise forward. Mike Hopkins, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, cited Pattinson's remarkable range, magnetic screen presence, and quiet intensity as the driving forces behind his selection. Director Denis Villeneuve echoed this sentiment, adding that Pattinson possesses the timeless soul of 007 while bringing an entirely new spirit…
items.t: Robert Pattinson Is Officially the Next James Bond

items.title: How Did A Secretlab Chair End Up in Every Room That Matters?
items.summary:
Once you notice it, you can't stop noticing it. It's behind Magnus Carlsen as he dismantles an opponent from home. It's under Hans Zimmer while he builds the low, seismic dread of Dune . It's the seat Keith Gill — Roaring Kitty to the internet — chose to sit on, in its Game of Thrones House Lannister trim, as he faced the US House Financial Services Committee. Jose Mourinho plots in one; Kevin De Bruyne recovers in one; Post Malone , Marshmello , iShowSpeed and Max Verstappen have all shown up in the same tall-backed silhouette.

A quick search for "gaming chair" pulls up dozens of near-identical products, which is exactly what makes the real question interesting. It isn't why gaming chairs are having a moment, but more of why this one keeps appearing in rooms that have nothing to do with each other.

View this post on Instagram 

A post shared by Verstappen Sim Racing (@verstappensimracing) 

To find out, I flew to Singapore, where Secretlab was founded in 2014 by two former StarCraft II semi-pros, Ian Ang and Alaric Choo. They were training in chairs they couldn't stand, so they decided to build their own.

The problem they were solving was specific and punishing. Competitive players can stay seated for up to 16 hours in a single training day. They swing between locked-in concentration and short breaks, and a chair built for that has to stay supportive through all of it, day after day. That spec made the chair a fixture at major esports tournaments, where pros compete for multi-million-dollar prize pools, and in the backgrounds of streamers broadcasting to millions from…
items.t: How Did A Secretlab Chair End Up in Every Room That Matters?

WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and Tokyo-based eyewear brand moseyec are taking on the SHIFT FRAME GLASS for their first-ever collaboration. The collaboration arrives alongside a major announcement for moseyec, which has officially unveiled Japanese rapper Vingo as the creative mastermind behind its operations.

Centering around moseyec’s signature “SHIFT FRAME GLASS”, and channeling Yohji Yamamoto’s signature design language, every single component of the collaborative eyewear has been painted to ensure an all-black palette. The frames feature a unique structural design that allows the wearer to detach the temples and swap out components for different visual expressions. Each pair is equipped with UV400 lenses, offering 99.9% UV protection.

Beyond the frames themselves, the premium presentation also extends to the packaging. Instead of the traditional luxury eyewear boxes, the sunglasses are housed in a custom spray can-shaped case. The canister not only serves as protection for the shades, but also operates as a nod to Vingo’s roots in street culture and the urban landscape of Tokyo. The limited-edition kit is rounded out by a co-branded cleaning cloth and box.

Constructed with premium Italian leather chosen for its distinct character, the footwear is available in four distinct colorways: a Black edition pays tribute to the original 2001 release, while Red, White, and Green editions serve as a nod to the Italian tricolor.  SKU: JF4566-900
 MSRP: $130 USD
 Release Date: Available Now
 Where to Buy: Nike 

Nike brings a heavy dose of nostalgia to its latest release with the Dunk Low Retro Premium “Grandma’s Couch,” officially arriving in a “Golden Hops/Velvet Brown” colorway. True to its playful nickname, the sneaker’s entire upper is wrapped in a rich, textured velvet fabric decorated with an elaborate, vintage-inspired floral brocade pattern. The deep autumnal palette of golden hues and velvety browns evokes the comforting, familiar aesthetic of classic living room upholstery. This heavily patterned execution transforms the traditional basketball silhouette into a highly tactile, lifestyle-focused statement piece perfect for the fall and winter seasons.

Contrasting the busy floral upper, the design incorporates carefully considered branding and structural embellishments. The iconic Nike Swooshes on both the medial and lateral sides are uniquely rendered using puffy white stitching, outlined by subtle brown piping that gives the logos a distinct, three-dimensional definition. To balance the warm tones, a muted "Pale Ivory" canvas tongue is matched by complementary laces and a premium leather inner lining. Finished with a classic rubber sole unit, the "Grandma's Couch" Dunk Low merges heritage athletic DNA with a cozy, granny-chic aesthetic.

items.title: Margot Robbie Set to Star in A24's 'The Week of Pain'
items.summary:

Margot Robbie will star in the upcoming film 'The Week of Pain' directed by Kristoffer BorgliA24 will finance and produce the project alongside Square Peg, Dilemma Films, and Robbie's LuckyChapThe announcement follows Borgli's recent box office success with The Drama starring Robert Pattinson and Zendaya

A24 is teaming up with director Kristoffer Borgli and actress Margot Robbie for an upcoming feature film titled The Week of Pain . Set to be financed and produced by A24, the project will also feature production contributions from Ari Aster and Lars Knudsen’s Square Peg banner, alongside Dilemma Films and Robbie’s own LuckyChap production company.

While official plot details for The Week of Pain remain heavily under wraps, the film is expected to deliver the squirmy, cringe-comedy drama that has become Borgli's signature following works like Dream Scenario and Sick of Myself . The new project reunites Square Peg and A24 with the filmmaker following their collaboration on April’s The Drama . That original dramedy, which starred Robert Pattinson and Zendaya, proved to be a massive box office success, grossing $135 million USD globally against a slim $28 million USD budget.

For Robbie, the casting announcement follows her recent appearance in the Warner Bros. cinematic adaptation of the literary romance Wuthering Heights . Starring alongside Jacob Elordi as Heathcliff, the film rocketed to $241 million USD worldwide. Looking ahead, the superstar is also set to star alongside Bradley Cooper in a highly anticipated Ocean’s 11 prequel centered around an epic heist…

G-SHOCK has reunited with its global brand ambassador, the seven-member X-POP group XG , G-SHOCK has teamed up with its global brand ambassador XG for a second collaboration watch. The seven-member group, made up of JURIN, CHISA, HINATA, HARVEY, JURIA, MAYA and COCONA, has built its own “X-POP” sound that sits outside the usual J-POP and K-POP lines, a rebellious streak Casio ties to G-SHOCK’s “Never Give Up” ethos.

The new GM-6900XG-8 is built around the creative concept “TIME, INKED ON YOU,” which treats the watch less as a tool for keeping time and more as something worn like ink on the wrist, carrying the feeling of XG’s music. It starts from the classic 6900 shape, adding a silvery metal bezel meant to evoke the weight of accumulated time, and a translucent band printed with the group’s full name, “Xtraordinary Genes,” in multi-angle print for a tattoo-like effect.

Packed with custom details honoring the septet, the watch features an engraved "X" motif on its signature front button. Pressing the "X" button will light up the display, revealing a howling wolf, which is the fandom’s symbol. The caseback is engraved with the Japanese character "緒," the last character of hesonoo, the chant the members share in a circle before going on stage, standing for the bond between XG and ALPHAZ. items.title: Buffer Plugs Into Sony’s Studio and Camcorder Legends for Its Latest Capsule
items.summary:
Summary 

Buffer has made its own version of Sony’s MDR-CD900ST studio headphones, labeled the Buffer SPThree graphic T-shirts are based on Sony hardware, from a broadcast monitor to a 2000s camcorderEach T-shirt has a small chest graphic and a larger back print that tells a different scene

Buffer has released a Sony -inspired capsule led by the MDR-CD900ST Buffer SP, its version of the Japanese studio headphone, alongside three graphic T-shirts based on Sony gear. The release celebrates the tools behind making and listening to music and video, from the recording booth to the skate video.

The MDR-CD900ST has long been a recording-studio standard for checking vocals and performances, and Buffer leaves the sound engineering untouched. The Buffer SP edition comes in black, with the Buffer logo and the line “Protecting you from the world friction” on the ear cup label. Specs follow the studio original: 63 Ω impedance, a 1,000 mW maximum input, a 5 to 30,000 Hz frequency response and a 2.5 m cable ending in a 6.3 mm stereo plug, with a 3.5 mm mini plug adapter included. The Sony headphones weigh about 200 g without the cable and are made in Japan, and they ship with a natural wood block.

The PVM-6041Q T-shirt is based on stacking monitors to make video art. Its back shows a wall of nine screens playing weather-forecast and news-style images next to “Buffy” and “Buffer” lettering, while a single monitor showing Buffy sits small on the chest. Front and back look intentionally different, and the shirt comes in White and Black.

The DCR-VX2000 T-shirt is the most personal of the…

items.title: Brain Dead x adidas Originals Complete the Adventure Collection With Apparel and Accessories

Brain Dead and adidas Originals are rounding out their ZUPERKLIMB revival with a full apparel and accessories collection that brings back adidas’ 2000s Adventure line from head to toe. The early-2000s approach shoe returns in the label’s signature hairy suede, but the clothing does just as much to carry the outdoor theme.

The standout is a half-zip fleece in a shaggy, long-pile knit, with an abstract mix of purple, brown and acid yellow broken up by an olive yoke, cuffs and hem. A garment-dyed lilac crewneck sweater takes a more vintage approach, with black Three Stripes down the sleeves and tonal embroidered logos on the chest. Dark grey nylon cargo pants have a crackled, all-over print, front pleats and a side cargo pocket with a co-branded patch. Product imagery also shows a brown tee with olive raglan sleeves, black stripes and red piping that the press release doesn’t mention. Each piece carries adidas’ Adventure logo, often alongside Brain Dead’s head motif.

The accessories bring the shaggy texture back. A fuzzy trapper-style beanie in lilac and brown has ear flaps, long braided ties and a bright yellow band spelling “DEAD” across the front. Olive-and-brown terry crew socks pair the Adventure logo with the Brain Dead…

items.title: The 14 best men’s boots for winter, from chelseas and lace-ups to wellies
items.summary:
Whether you want minimalist or heritage, waterproof or suede, our menswear expert has rounded up the most stylish pairs for every occasion and outfit

• The best men’s coats for autumn and winter

I haven’t always worn boots. For years I wrote them off – at 5ft 8in, I was convinced anything above the ankle would make my legs look shorter. Then I started wearing them with the right trousers – a straight leg that falls over the top – and realised I’d spent a decade getting winter wrong. All anyone sees is a smart pair of shoes that happens to keep your ankles warm.

Here’s the thing: boots needn’t be intimidating. They’re just the wintry version of the leather shoes you already own. A chelsea is your loafer – it goes with pretty much everything in your wardrobe and every event in your diary, Christmas parties included. A derby boot is laced up, a bit sturdier and just as happy with jeans. The chukka is your weekend trainer. And the chunky, rubber-soled ones? Just think of them as an umbrella for your feet.
